wire.t: Nov 12: Thursday night is Washington at the New York Giants (8:15 PM ET, Prime Video). Giants coach John Harbaugh said Cam Skattebo should be full go after missing Week 9 with a hamstring. FatMikeR, that one is yours: check the Bijan is your daddy lineup before kickoff.
Nov 11: The Rams hope Puka Nacua returns in about five weeks from a knee injury (Sleeper lists an MCL sprain, out). He is on the Llamageddon roster, and the Rams are on bye in Week 11.

Nov 11: Josh Jacobs will miss Week 10 after finger surgery, so Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is without him against Stroud of Turin. Expect a Packers committee of MarShawn Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong.

Nov 11: Bill_Buttlicker rebuilt the Lawrence of a Labia bench: dropped Drew Lock (questionable, elbow) for Tutu Atwell, dropped Gardner Minshew II (out for the season, UCL) for Konata Mumpfield, and added rookie QB Fernando Mendoza. Trevor Lawrence is still the starter.

Nov 11: More free agents: OneSillyBannana dropped Efton Chism III for TreVeyon Henderson, krunkdd cut Baker Mayfield (Tampa Bay is on bye), and Pudge247 cut Kalif Raymond (Chicago on bye) for Denver WR Pat Bryant, who practiced fully after being designated to return from IR.
Nov 11: Week 10 waivers are in. krunkdd won Jakobi Meyers for 22 FAAB (Pudge247 bid 5, dstafford4254 bid 0) and cut Chris Bell. Pudge247 won Tank Dell for 20 FAAB after Dell scored 20.5 in Week 9.

Nov 11: Also on waivers: ChuckJ10 added Darren Waller for 3 FAAB and J.J. McCarthy for 0, RedDevil904 swapped Jake Ferguson for Pat Freiermuth, dcrabb and krunkdd each paid 2 for a defense (Green Bay and Baltimore), and OneSillyBannana added Justice Hill and Reggie Virgil and cut Marvin Harrison Jr.

Nov 11: Week 10 byes are Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay. That takes out Bucky Irving for Nothing to see here, Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton for Ivefallenandicantgetup, D'Andre Swift for Wild Goose Chase, Rome Odunze and Saquon Barkley for MY DAD IS DEAD, Dallas Goedert for Stroud of Turin and the Denver defense for Llamageddon.

stories.title: Thursday lineup check: ChuckJ10 still has Bucky Irving on bye and an empty spot, and dcrabb is still starting Denver's defense
stories.dek: Two lineups are still carrying zeros as of Thursday morning, the commish spent Wednesday shuffling quarterbacks, and Llamageddon lost Puka Nacua for weeks.
body: Kickoff for Week 10 is tonight, and as of Thursday morning two Fantasy Addicks lineups are still holding guaranteed zeros. ChuckJ10 has Bucky Irving in the Nothing to see here lineup with Tampa Bay on bye, plus an empty starting spot, for a 2-7 team that is a 10.5-point underdog to Lawrence of a Labia. ChuckJ10 added Darren Waller and J.J. McCarthy on Wednesday and still did not fill the hole. There are no games to blame. It is a button.

dcrabb paid 2 FAAB for the Green Bay defense because Denver is on bye, and then left the Denver defense in the Llamageddon starting lineup. That is paying for the fix and not installing it. Llamageddon is still a 20.5-point favorite over MY DAD IS DEAD, but that number got smaller today: the Rams hope Puka Nacua is back in about five weeks from a knee injury, and he will not help anybody until December. dcrabb has spent 5 FAAB all season, so there is plenty in the tank for a replacement receiver.

The commish was busy too. Bill_Buttlicker dropped Drew Lock (questionable with an elbow injury, 27.4 points in two starts), dropped Gardner Minshew II (out for the season) and added Fernando Mendoza, who has 2.22 fantasy points in one game, plus Rams receivers Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield. Cutting Minshew was required. Trading the guy who scored 12.6 on the Lawrence of a Labia bench in Week 9 for a guy with 2.22 is a choice, and the 44-55 all-play record says Bill_Buttlicker should not be making choices.

Elsewhere: krunkdd cut Baker Mayfield, Pudge247 swapped Kalif Raymond for Pat Bryant, who is on bye this week but practiced fully after his IR return designation, and OneSillyBannana dropped Efton Chism III, who scored 15.9 on the MY DAD IS DEAD bench in Week 9. Cam Skattebo is expected to play tonight for the Giants, so FatMikeR should check the Bijan is your daddy lineup before 8:15 PM ET.

stories.title: Week 10 preview: NjigbaR Please! is a 15.5-point favorite, and byes widen two lines
stories.dek: Lead Nagger hosts Achane in the Membrane, Wild Goose Chase is up to an 11.5-point favorite, and every WR and TE slot is a payout ticket.
body: Week 10 is live. NjigbaR Please! (7-2) faces Bijan is your daddy (3-6) and is a 15.5-point favorite. Ivefallenandicantgetup (7-2) draws Wild Goose Chase, the highest-scoring team in the league at 1,185.74 points, and is an 11.5-point underdog after a 3-point nudge for Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton being on bye.

Lead Nagger (6-3) plays Achane in the Membrane (3-6) and is favored by 8.5. Lawrence of a Labia (6-3) plays Nothing to see here (2-7) and is favored by 10.5, a 3-point nudge because Bucky Irving is on bye. Bill_Buttlicker has a 44-55 all-play record to prove he does not deserve it.

Stroud of Turin (5-4) plays Breece'sBurdenDeflowered (5-4) in the coin flip of the week, 4.5 points apart. Llamageddon (4-5) is a 20.5-point favorite over MY DAD IS DEAD (1-8), the biggest spread of Week 10.

Sleeper lists Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle as out, and Puka Nacua, Patrick Mahomes and Drew Lock as questionable. Check the status before kickoff. Week 10's payout is Highest-Scoring Receiver, so every WR and TE slot is a lottery ticket.

stories.title: krunkdd drops 22 FAAB on Jakobi Meyers to patch a bye-week hole, and Pudge247 buys Tank Dell for 20
stories.dek: The 7-2 co-leader outbid Lead Nagger by 17 dollars, ChuckJ10 finally found a tight end, and OneSillyBannana cut Marvin Harrison Jr. for Reggie Virgil.
body: Waivers cleared overnight and the biggest check came from the guy tied for first. krunkdd paid 22 FAAB for Jakobi Meyers, beating Pudge247's 5 and dstafford4254's 0, and cut Chris Bell to make room. Meyers has 75.6 PPR points in eight games (9.45 a game) and scored 10.5 in Week 9. It is not a luxury buy: Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton are both on bye this week, and Sleeper shows Ivefallenandicantgetup with two empty lineup spots, one of them the defense, heading into a game against Wild Goose Chase. krunkdd also paid 2 for the Baltimore defense and dropped Philadelphia, which is on bye.

Pudge247 lost the Meyers bid and won Tank Dell for 20 instead. Dell caught 4 balls for 105 yards and a touchdown in Week 9 (20.5 points), so at least Pudge247 bought the guy who just did something. Lead Nagger also cut Devin Singletary, Kalif Raymond and Darius Cooper this week, which is a lot of roster churn for a 6-3 team with the second-most points in the league. Pudge247 has now spent 150 FAAB this season.

ChuckJ10 added Darren Waller for 3 FAAB and J.J. McCarthy for 0 after starting Greg Dulcich (3.4) at tight end in Week 9, and cut Dulcich, Tyjae Spears and Terrance Ferguson (on IR) over the last two days. RedDevil904 dropped Jake Ferguson for Pat Freiermuth, and that one is not a roast: the Cowboys say Ferguson will miss multiple weeks. dcrabb paid 2 for the Green Bay defense because Denver is on bye.

And then there is OneSillyBannana, who cut Marvin Harrison Jr. (4.0 in Week 9) for Reggie Virgil (3.5 in Week 9), swapped Joe Milton for Justice Hill and traded the Chicago defense for Kansas City on the bye. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-8, a 20.5-point underdog to Llamageddon, and has spent 200 FAAB this year. FatMikeR has spent 0 and is 3-6, so there are two ways to be bad at this.

stories.title: Bye-pocalypse: Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay are off, and Ivefallenandicantgetup and Nothing to see here feel it most
stories.dek: Bucky Irving is still sitting in ChuckJ10's lineup, krunkdd has two empty spots, and dcrabb already bought a backup defense.
body: Four teams are on bye in Week 10: the Bears, Broncos, Eagles and Buccaneers. Nothing to see here gets hit hardest in the lineup: Bucky Irving (159.1 points this season, 17.7 a game) is on bye and was still listed as a starter in Sleeper this morning, next to an empty spot. ChuckJ10 is a 10.5-point underdog to Lawrence of a Labia after a 3-point nudge for that.

Ivefallenandicantgetup loses Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton, which is why krunkdd paid 22 for Jakobi Meyers. Sleeper still shows two empty lineup spots for the 7-2 co-leader, so Wild Goose Chase is now an 11.5-point favorite after a 3-point nudge. Br0phy has his own bye problem with D'Andre Swift (153.8 points) off, but Swift is not in the current Wild Goose Chase lineup.

MY DAD IS DEAD loses Rome Odunze and Saquon Barkley, Stroud of Turin loses Dallas Goedert, Lawrence of a Labia has DeVonta Smith, J.K. Dobbins and Kyle Monangai on Chicago, Denver and Philadelphia, and Lead Nagger has Emeka Egbuka on Tampa Bay. None of those players is in a current starting lineup. Bo Nix is on bye too, sitting on FatMikeR's bench.

Llamageddon still has the Denver defense in the lineup, but dcrabb paid 2 FAAB for Green Bay, so that should be fixed by Sunday. Thursday night is Washington at the Giants. Check your lineup before 8:15 PM ET, because the Week 10 payout is Highest-Scoring Receiver and an empty slot scores zero.

rumors.t: krunkdd has reportedly paid 22 FAAB for Jakobi Meyers and asked Sleeper whether that also covers a lineup that fills itself in.

ChuckJ10 has reportedly petitioned Sleeper to put a 'dream matchup' button next to Lawrence of a Labia.

trades.why: Pudge247 has Joe Burrow and nobody behind him. FatMikeR has Jayden Daniels and Bo Nix (15.68 on the bench in Week 9) and a thin backfield. Emmett Johnson (10.56 on Pudge247's bench) fits.
dcrabb starts Jared Goff and has Brock Purdy. Br0phy has Drake Maye, Jordan Love (36.18 on the bench in Week 9) and Bryce Young, and wants a running back. Rachaad White is the swap.

krunkdd needs wide receiver help behind Chris Godwin Jr. (4.8 in Week 9) and has plenty of backs. Bill_Buttlicker needs a running back who plays. Jordan Addison (4.8) for Javonte Williams works for both.

RedDevil904 now has three tight ends after adding Pat Freiermuth (Dallas Goedert, Kenyon Sadiq, Freiermuth) and a thin backfield. ChuckJ10 has a deep running back room with Chris Rodriguez Jr. (11.2 on the bench in Week 9) and is relying on Darren Waller, a 3-FAAB pickup, at tight end. Goedert is on bye this week, so this is a rest-of-season deal.
Bill_Buttlicker gives Tony Pollard (29.7) and George Kittle for Chig Okonkwo (3.2). He wants the headline. OneSillyBannana wants a win. Nobody should get this.
Ja'Marr Chase (31.1) for J.K. Dobbins (1.3), straight up. RedDevil904 would be taking a running back who started at 1.3 for a receiver who scored 31.1.
Justin Jefferson (14.3) for Bryce Young (10.36). ChuckJ10 already starts Caleb Williams and would be sending out a starting receiver. Br0phy already has four quarterbacks.

columns.title: TWENTY-TWO DOLLARS FOR JAKOBI MEYERS?! KRUNKDD IS PLAYING CHESS AND THE REST OF YOU ARE EATING THE PIECES!
columns.dek: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner watched the Week 10 waiver run and has lost his voice for the fifth time this season.
body: I'M SORRY, I NEED EVERYONE TO SIT DOWN. krunkdd is 7-2. TIED FOR FIRST. Four straight wins! And this man looks at his roster, sees Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton on bye, and does not panic. He does not cry. He walks into the waiver office and puts down TWENTY-TWO FAAB on Jakobi Meyers! 75.6 points in eight games! THAT IS A MAN WHO KNOWS WHAT A BYE WEEK IS!

And who did he beat? PUDGE247! Pudge247 bid FIVE DOLLARS. FIVE! You are 6-3 with the second-most points in the league and you bid FIVE DOLLARS like you were tipping a valet! And dstafford4254 bid ZERO. ZERO! The 7-2 co-leader put in a bid of ZERO on a starting receiver, which is not a bid, THAT IS A WISH!

Now, credit where it is due. Pudge247 turned around and paid 20 for Tank Dell, who just went 4 catches, 105 yards and a touchdown for 20.5. Fine! FINE! But you also cut Devin Singletary, Kalif Raymond AND Darius Cooper in two days! That is not a roster, Pudge247, THAT IS A REVOLVING DOOR!

And OneSillyBannana. OH, OneSillyBannana. You cut Marvin Harrison Jr. for Reggie Virgil. Harrison scored 4.0 in Week 9. Virgil scored 3.5. You DOWNGRADED by half a point ON PURPOSE! You are 1-8! You have spent 200 FAAB! And you are a 20.5-point underdog!

Meanwhile krunkdd is sitting on 58 FAAB spent all season and a share of first place. EFFICIENCY! DISCIPLINE! TWENTY-TWO DOLLARS! If Ivefallenandicantgetup fills those two empty lineup spots before Sunday, I am buying a jersey. I DON'T KNOW WHOSE. I'M BUYING IT ANYWAY!

columns.title: A bye week is on the schedule. Starting one anyway is soft.
columns.dek: Nothing to see here and Llamageddon are carrying zeros into Week 10. Dick Fitzwell has seen enough.
body: I played linebacker. If my coach put a guy on the field who was not in the building, we would run until we threw up. That is what ChuckJ10 did. Bucky Irving is in the Nothing to see here lineup and Tampa Bay is on bye. Next to him is an empty spot. Two zeros. Thursday morning. Soft.

Look at the record. Nothing to see here is 2-7 with 947.92 points, the second-lowest total in the league, and 1,148.08 against, the most in the league. You do not have points to give away. You picked up Darren Waller and J.J. McCarthy on Wednesday and still left the hole. You did the hard part and skipped the easy part.

dcrabb is not off the hook. Paid 2 FAAB for the Green Bay defense because Denver is on bye. Denver is still in the Llamageddon lineup. That is buying a mouthguard and leaving it in the car. You are a 20.5-point favorite. Favorites who stop doing the little things become 4-6.

Bill_Buttlicker, I watched your tape too. Dropped Drew Lock and his 27.4 points in two starts for Fernando Mendoza and his 2.22. Lock is hurt, fine. Mendoza is not a plan. Trevor Lawrence is your starter and you have no backup worth the roster spot. Fix your lineups. It takes ten seconds. Do it.

columns.title: Six things to do before Thursday Night Football, ranked by Oliver Klozoff
columns.dek: Lineups start locking tonight. Oliver Klozoff has a plan and a cooler.
body: Thursday is the most important day of the fantasy week because it is the first one. Here is what to do, in order, from my lawn chair.

1. Start every player on bye. ChuckJ10 is starting Bucky Irving on a Tampa Bay bye, and dcrabb is starting the Denver defense on a Denver bye. Bye players cannot get hurt, cannot fumble and cannot throw a pick. Zero is the only score that is never negative. Simple. 2. Leave one spot empty. An empty spot cannot underperform. Nothing to see here has one, and I respect it.

3. Drop your backup quarterback for a worse one. Bill_Buttlicker cut Drew Lock (27.4 points in two games) and added Fernando Mendoza (2.22 points in one game). Mendoza has played fewer games, which means he is fresher. The commish is 6-3. Do the math. 4. Never spend FAAB. FatMikeR has spent 0 of his budget and is 3-6, and OneSillyBannana has spent all 200 and is 1-8. FatMikeR has two more wins for 200 fewer dollars. That is the best value in the league.

5. Cut the guy who scored on your bench. OneSillyBannana dropped Efton Chism III one week after Chism scored 15.9 on the MY DAD IS DEAD bench. If he scores on your bench, he was never going to score in your lineup, because he would know you were watching. 6. Bet the 20.5-point underdog. MY DAD IS DEAD has lost eight straight, so the law of averages says the next nine are wins. I have never been wrong about averages, mainly because I do not check.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: the FAAB data says FatMikeR is the best manager in the league, and the math is undefeated
columns.dek: Wins per FAAB dollar is the only stat that matters, and one team has an infinite number of them.
body: I built a new model this week, and I want to be clear that it is the most important model in fantasy football. It is called Wins Per FAAB Dollar. You take a team's wins and divide by the FAAB it has spent this season. That's it. That's the model. The league has spent 1,320 FAAB dollars this year, so there is plenty of data.

The leader is FatMikeR. Bijan is your daddy has 3 wins and has spent 0 FAAB, and 3 divided by 0 is, according to my spreadsheet, a red error box, which I am interpreting as infinity. FatMikeR is infinitely efficient. Second is dcrabb at 0.8 wins per dollar (4 wins, 5 FAAB), and third is Bill_Buttlicker at 0.667 (6 wins, 9 FAAB). The commish is buying wins at about $1.50 each, which is cheaper than a hot dog at any stadium in America.

At the bottom is OneSillyBannana. MY DAD IS DEAD has 1 win and 200 FAAB spent, which is 0.005 wins per dollar, or $200 per win. ChuckJ10 is next at 0.014 (2 wins, 142 FAAB, $71 a win). rtmcruise has spent 200 for 5 wins and RedDevil904 190 for 5, so those two are paying about $40 a win. dstafford4254 has spent 200 and is 7-2, which my model calls 'statistical noise.'

Which brings me to this week. krunkdd paid 22 for Jakobi Meyers and 2 for a defense, which brings Ivefallenandicantgetup to 58 spent and 7 wins, or 0.121 wins per dollar. Pudge247 paid 20 for Tank Dell and is at 150 for 6 wins, 0.04. My model says Pudge247 should have bid 0 on everything and won the league. My model has never been wrong, because I have never checked it.
Final projection: Bijan is your daddy wins the title on efficiency. FatMikeR is a 15.5-point underdog to NjigbaR Please! this week, but my spreadsheet does not have a column for points.

commish.title: Contacts for Your Mom
commish.dek: The two men who run this league, collect your money, and answer to no one.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

body: The thirteenth man in a twelve-team league and the voice of the auction. marco_polo doesn't own a team, which is the only reason nobody has accused him of rigging the bidding.

He opens the bidding, calls the room to order and decides when the hammer drops. As the C.U.C.K., he is also the one called in when the commissioners hit a crisis nobody saw coming. Ask him a question and he answers faster than anyone in the league can think about it. Respect the gavel.
